description: Election Commission - Declare that M. S. Muhammed Hayas was Selected as the Member of the Kurunegala Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Kurunegala Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for a local authority position, including the nomination and declaration of a new member to fill a vacancy caused by a member ceasing to belong to their political party. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) which cover electoral processes, candidate nominations, and declarations related to local authorities.
